problem.zh: AI 按资料写的回答和草稿，会悄悄改掉日期、数字，或者多出资料里没有的话；要让每句事实都附逐字原文，再用脚本核对
problem.en: Answers and drafts written from documents quietly shift dates and numbers or add facts no document states; every factual sentence should carry a word-for-word quote that a script checks

primary_metric.zh: 埋进去的错误被标出的比例；正确事实被误标的比例；编造数字的回答数
primary_metric.en: Planted errors flagged; correct facts wrongly flagged; answers with an invented number

summary.zh: 一个 Agent Skill 加一个核对脚本。Skill 让 Agent 给每句事实附上资料里逐字的原文；脚本核对两件事：原文真的在所引的文件里（大小写、空格、弯引号和标点不计较），以及这句话里的日期、时间、金额和数量也都出现在原文里，中英文数字互认（例如“下午2点”和 14:00）。脚本判断不了意思，所以 Skill 还要求 Agent 逐条读一遍通过的说法。两种用法：按资料回答问题；核对一篇草稿。
summary.en: An Agent Skill plus a checker script. The skill has the agent attach a word-for-word quote from the documents to every factual sentence; the script checks that the quote is really in the cited file (case, spacing, curly quotes and punctuation forgiven) and that every date, time, amount and count in the sentence also appears in its quotes, across Chinese and English numerals ("下午2点" matches 14:00). The script cannot judge meaning, so the skill also has the agent reread every passing claim. Two modes: answer from documents, and check a draft.

did.zh: 我把 TraceDesk 里逐字核对引文和数字的规则抽出来，做成谁都能装的 Skill 加核对脚本；先在开发评测里找问题、改出 v0.2，再在冻结的留出题上和普通提示比较；之后按真实使用中的误报和待改清单两次改规则（0.3.0、0.4.0），每次改之前先写好新题。
did.en: I took TraceDesk's word-for-word quote and number rules out into a skill and checker anyone can install; found problems in a development run, wrote v0.2, and compared it with a plain prompt on frozen held-out items; then revised the rules twice (0.3.0, 0.4.0) from false alarms in real use and a list of known gaps, writing new items before each change.

summary.en: A desk that answers questions from an organisation's published rules and quotes them word for word. The public instance uses 58 public Monash student pages. Retrieval translates the question into English, then runs vector search and reranking; quotes in the answer are shown only after they pass the check, and paraphrases that do not match word for word are withheld. The evaluation compares seven retrieval methods.

did.zh: 我们做了按公开规定回答、逐字引原文的问答台：先选校区再提问，检索、生成、在代码里核对引文；用 45 道写好正确页面的题比较 7 种检索做法，再用学生的真实提问单独测。
did.en: We built a desk that answers from published rules with word-for-word quotes: pick a campus, ask, then retrieval, generation and quote checking in code; seven retrieval methods were compared on 45 questions with known right pages, and real student questions were scored separately.

summary.en: An FAQ assistant that answers only from the given documents, designed for readers who find dense text hard: bottom line first, then steps and deadlines, each with a word-for-word quote. Quotes are checked before display and failures are withheld. The demo documents describe a fictional event, DemoClub. The evaluation compares a plain prompt with the grounded prompt series on the same model.

name.zh: 有据可查的简历初筛
name.en: Evidence-backed resume screening

problem.zh: 用模型初筛简历时，每个“符合 / 不符合”都要附简历原文；看它会不会更准、换名字性别学校后结论会不会变
problem.en: When a model screens resumes, every met / not-met verdict should carry a resume quote; does that make it more accurate, and do verdicts change when name, gender or school change

primary_metric.zh: 逐条要求判对率；换名字等之后去留有没有变；正确的“符合”被核对误伤的比例
primary_metric.en: Requirement verdicts right; advance decisions that change when names and other details change; correct "met" verdicts lost to the quote check

summary.zh: 检验一件事：让模型给每个“符合 / 不符合”附上简历原文、再用 evidence-check 的脚本核对，初筛会不会更准、在换掉名字、性别、学校、休学、婚育之后更稳。岗位和简历全部虚构，答案在写简历时定好。做了四版评测：第一版看准确和稳定，第二版改核对的接法，第三版用更乱、带陷阱的简历，另做了植入错误测试和第二次独立复核。
summary.en: Tests whether having the model attach a resume quote to every met / not-met verdict, checked by the evidence-check script, makes screening more accurate and more stable when name, gender, school, career gaps or marital details change. All jobs and resumes are fictional and answers were fixed when the resumes were written. Four rounds: accuracy and stability, a better way to wire the check, messier resumes with traps, plus planted-error tests and an independent second review.

did.zh: 我写了虚构的岗位和简历、事先定好答案，比较普通打分、附原文、附原文加脚本核对几种做法；发现核对的接法会误伤正确的判断以后，改了两版接法；再用带陷阱的新简历、植入错误和第二次独立复核检验。
did.en: I wrote fictional jobs and resumes with answers fixed in advance and compared plain scoring, quotes, and quotes plus the script; after finding that the check discarded correct verdicts I rewired it twice; then tested with trap-laden new resumes, planted errors and an independent second review.

name.zh: 卖点体检
name.en: Sellpoint Check

problem.zh: 商品页的卖点有没有被买家评价证实：买家只看到被证实的卖点和原话，其余卖点私下交给商家，附修改建议
problem.en: Which listing claims do buyer reviews confirm: buyers see only confirmed claims with quotes, and the rest go privately to the merchant with suggested rewrites

primary_metric.zh: 卖点判对率（证实、反驳、有争议、没提到）；每个商品的调用次数和费用
primary_metric.en: Claims labelled correctly (supported, refuted, mixed, not mentioned); calls and cost per product

summary.zh: 把商品页的卖点拆开，在买家评价里找支持或反驳的原话，每段原话用 evidence-check 的脚本逐字核对，再给每条卖点贴上“证实、反驳、有争议、没提到”。买家页只展示被证实的卖点和原话；没被证实的进商家后台的“卖点体检”，附原话和修改建议，只有商家本人看得到。评测比较三种找证据的做法：先检索再判断（A）、逐条评价判断再汇总（B，照 PRAISE 论文的做法）、全部评价一次交给模型（C，采用）。
summary.en: The listing's claims are split out, buyer reviews are searched for quotes that support or refute each one, every quote is checked word for word by the evidence-check script, and each claim is labelled supported, refuted, mixed or not mentioned. The buyer page shows only supported claims with their quotes; the rest go to the merchant's private claim check with quotes and a suggested rewrite. The evaluation compares three ways of finding evidence: retrieve then judge (A), judge review by review and aggregate (B, after the PRAISE paper), and all reviews in one call (C, adopted).

did.zh: 我把卖点核对设计成平台和商家一起用的功能：买家只看被证实的卖点，其余私下交给商家；比较三种找证据的做法的准确率和费用；给商家的修改建议迭代了六版，每版先在新写的冻结题上测，再决定用不用。
did.en: I designed claim checking as a feature the platform and merchants share: buyers see only confirmed claims, the rest go privately to the merchant; compared three evidence-finding methods on accuracy and cost; and iterated the merchant advice six times, testing each version on new frozen items before deciding.

name.zh: 有据审核（广告审核 Agent）
name.en: Grounded Review (ad-review agent)

problem.zh: 广告审核要说得出违反哪一条、是哪几个字违反的，而不只是给“通过 / 拒绝”
problem.en: An ad decision should name the rule and the exact words that break it, not just approve or reject

primary_metric.zh: 判对率（放行和拒绝都算）；违规拦截率；条款引对率
primary_metric.en: Decisions right (approve and reject); violations caught; clauses cited correctly

summary.zh: 审核广告的 Agent：读文案和图片里的字，在 32 条政策条款里查依据，给出放行或拒绝；每处违规附类别、条款、违规原话和条款原文，引文先过 evidence-check 的核对脚本才算数。广告主追问时，它写修改后的版本，再复审广告主自己改的版本。评测对比两组：把材料一次交给模型的单个提示词，和带工具的 Agent。
summary.en: An agent that reviews ads: it reads the caption and the words in the image, looks up 32 policy clauses, and approves or rejects. Every violation carries a category, the clause, the offending words and the clause text, and every quote must pass the evidence-check script before it counts. When the advertiser asks, it writes a corrected version and re-reviews the advertiser's own revision. The evaluation compares two arms: a single prompt with all material, and a tool-using agent.

did.zh: 我从官方原文整理了 32 条政策条款，写了带陷阱的留出集，做了能查条款、引原文、多轮改稿和复审的 Agent，并和单个提示词、违禁词表、开源审核模型比较；改稿建议从 v1 迭代到 v1.3；最后换成监管机构和法院定答案的真实广告。
did.en: I extracted 32 policy clauses from official sources, wrote a held-out set with traps, built an agent that looks up clauses, quotes them, revises and re-reviews over several turns, and compared it with a single prompt, a banned-word list and open-source moderation models; iterated the advice from v1 to v1.3; then switched to real ads judged by regulators and courts.

summary.zh: 用 20 个固定任务（16 张图、4 段视频）测 Seedream 4.0、4.5、5.0 lite 和 Seedance 1.0 pro 画中文卖点文字稳不稳。每张图的文字用 OCR 逐字核对，可疑处对照原图复看；每个作品按评分表独立打 3 次分。结果写成给商家的创作指南，另做了一个浏览器里的上线前核对工具：放进商品图和要求的文字，逐行查哪里不一样、哪里多了字，图片不上传。
summary.en: Twenty fixed tasks (16 images, 4 videos) test how reliably Seedream 4.0, 4.5 and 5.0 lite and Seedance 1.0 pro render Chinese selling-point text. Text in every image is checked character by character with OCR, with doubtful cases compared against the image; every work is rated three times, independently, against a rubric. The results became a guide for merchants plus an in-browser pre-listing checker: drop in a product image and the required text, and it lists line by line what differs or was added, without uploading the image.

did.zh: 我定了 20 个固定任务、生成前冻结评分表，用 OCR 逐字核对画面里的字，并按评分表独立评三次；把结论写成给商家的创作指南，另做了一个在浏览器里查错字、不上传图片的上线前核对工具。
did.en: I fixed 20 tasks and froze the rubric before generation, checked the text in every image character by character with OCR and rated each work three times against the rubric; turned the findings into a guide for merchants and built an in-browser pre-listing checker that never uploads the image.

name.zh: 实时语音 Agent 体验评测
name.en: Real-time voice agent evaluation

problem.zh: 语音助手在用户停顿、插话、说“嗯”、背景有人说话时还能不能把事办对，体验用时延、打断、误停的数字来衡量
problem.en: Whether a voice assistant still gets the task right when the user pauses, interrupts, says "mm" or talks over background speech, with experience measured as latency, barge-in and false-stop numbers

primary_metric.zh: 严格通过率（事办对且交互对）；开口时延中位数；插话停下率；附和后继续说的比例
primary_metric.en: Strict pass (task and interaction right); median time to first audio; barge-ins stopped; backchannels talked through

summary.zh: 测一条串联的实时语音 Agent（静音检测 → 语音识别 → 带工具的模型 → 语音合成）在 42 段写好的中英对话里的表现：停顿、插话、附和词、噪声、工具调用。每段对话的答案在写题时定好，跑前冻结题目、音频和打分脚本。先测三种基线设置和纯文字对照，再在同一套题上一项一项试改进：附和不算打断、先暂停再确认、第一段语音切短、删除前先确认、只听主说话人，最后把有效的合在一起。
summary.en: Measures a cascaded real-time voice agent (voice activity detection → speech recognition → a model with tools → speech synthesis) on 42 scripted Chinese and English conversations covering pauses, interruptions, backchannels, noise and tool calls. Answers were fixed when the items were written; items, audio and scorer were frozen before the run. Three baseline settings and a text-only control come first; fixes are then tried one at a time on the same items (backchannels are not barge-ins, pause before cancelling, a shorter first speech chunk, confirm before deleting, listen only to the primary speaker), and the useful ones are combined.

did.zh: 我写了 42 段带停顿、插话、附和和噪声的对话、事先定好答案，搭了一条本机串联的语音 Agent 做基线；然后一项一项试改进，每项先写补充预注册再跑，最后把有效的合在一起。
did.en: I wrote 42 conversations with pauses, barge-ins, backchannels and noise, answers fixed in advance, and built a local cascaded voice agent as the baseline; then tried fixes one at a time, each with its own preregistration addendum, and combined the ones that worked.

name.zh: 有据标注流水线
name.en: Grounded Labelling Pipeline

problem.zh: 能核对的回答，怎么变成团队每天用的审核工作流：拿不准的交给人复核，提示词能灰度、能回滚
problem.en: How checkable answers become a review workflow a team runs daily: unsure cases go to people, and prompts ship with canary release and rollback

primary_metric.zh: 漏网错判（判错又自动生效）；送人工复核的比例；判对率
primary_metric.en: Wrong decisions that went live; share sent to human review; decisions right

summary.zh: 一条围绕有据审核搭的审核和标注工作流。每条广告先由模型判断并引原文，再用 evidence-check 核对引文，核对没过、读不出或模型拿不准的进人工复核队列，复核结果和模型不同的变成新的回归题。提示词按版本管理，新版本先做回归测试，再按事先写好的规则灰度放量，触发就回滚。流量是有据审核评测题的回放，不是真实用户；回放里的复核结论就是题目定好的答案。
summary.en: A review and labelling workflow built around Grounded Review. Each ad is decided by the model with quotes, the quotes are checked by evidence-check, and ads that fail the check, cannot be read or that the model is unsure of go to a human review queue; reviewed ads that differ from the model become new regression items. Prompts are versioned; a new version passes a regression test, then a canary release under rules written beforehand, and rolls back when a rule fires. Traffic is a replay of Grounded Review's test items, not real users; reviewer decisions in the replay are the items' fixed answers.

did.zh: 我把有据审核做成一条四步审核工作流：模型判断，evidence-check 核对引文，核对没过或模型拿不准的进人工复核队列，复核结果回流成回归题；另加政策库检索评测、提示词版本、灰度和回滚规则、每周报告和上线检查清单，复核队列可以同步到 Lark 多维表格。
did.en: I turned Grounded Review into a four-step review workflow: the model decides, evidence-check verifies the quotes, ads that fail the check or that the model is unsure of go to a human review queue, and reviewed ads come back as regression items; plus a policy retrieval evaluation, prompt versions, canary and rollback rules, weekly reports and a launch checklist, with the review queue syncable to Lark Base.
